assumption: Project name means the repository root directory name, matching the board's existing root identity because no separate authored project-name field is in scope.
guidance: Resolved by correction, not by confirmation: the original assumption (project name = repository directory name) was WRONG — forge init --name authors it into run.json. Implementation went further after story review showed run.json is lifecycle state a data-only tree never has: project_identity now reads three sources, most authoritative first — the authored name, then the BRIEF's H1 (committed; sign-off refuses without it), then the resolved directory. Documented in the function's docstring and pinned by test_project_name_survives_the_run_state_lifecycle (init -> intake -> shipped shape) and test_project_name_falls_back_to_the_brief_when_run_state_is_absent.
